summary.content:
Today's selection covers 48 articles from 6 trusted sources, including 33 on Artificial Intelligence and 12 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Live updates from Elon Musk and Sam Altman’s court battle over the future of OpenAI
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Live updates from Elon Musk and Sam Altman’s court battle over the future of OpenAI
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights phishing, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, TechCrunch, BleepingComputer, SecurityWeek, BBC Technology and others
• **Fresh Content**: 25 articles published in the last 24 hours
